stories.title: US and Iran Exchange Strikes
stories.details: The US and Iran traded strikes for the first time in a month, reigniting hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz. The US targeted rocket launchers on Larak Island, while Iran retaliated with ballistic missiles at American bases in Jordan, resulting in reported casualties.

stories.title: Military Attack in Niger
stories.details: Soldiers in Niger launched an attack on the presidential palace, the airport, and a base hosting Russian mercenaries. The situation remains volatile as regional instability continues to escalate.

stories.title: Deadly Russian Strike in Ukraine
stories.details: A Russian missile strike on a weapons depot in Ukraine has killed at least 37 people. It is reported to be one of the deadliest attacks on the country this year.

stories.title: Iceland Rejects EU Negotiations
stories.details: Icelandic voters have rejected a proposal to resume negotiations on joining the European Union. The 'no' side secured 52.8 percent of the vote, effectively halting the process.

stories.title: Violence in the West Bank
stories.details: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, drawing a rare condemnation from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The incident highlights the ongoing tensions in the region.

stories.title: Early Prison Release Scheme Changes
stories.details: Andy Burnham has unveiled sweeping changes to the early release scheme, making thousands of dangerous criminals eligible for release. Critics warn the prison system is now 'one major event from disaster' due to capacity issues.

stories.title: Petition to Save Prince Charles Cinema
stories.details: Filmmaker Christopher Nolan is backing a petition to save the iconic London cinema. The owner claims the venue is facing a 'punitive' lease increase that threatens its future.

stories.title: Tusla Crisis in Ireland
stories.details: The Irish child and family agency, Tusla, is facing scrutiny for awarding a €2.5m contract despite conflict of interest concerns. Senior officials have warned of a 'crisis' as children in state care are left without proper accommodation.

stories.title: UK National Park Housing Premium
stories.details: A new study reveals that properties located within UK national parks command a 24% price premium compared to similar homes elsewhere. This highlights the ongoing pressure in the UK housing market.

stories.title: Nepal-Tibet Flood Disaster
stories.details: Flash flooding triggered by a high-altitude landslide and glacial collapse has devastated regions in Nepal and Tibet. At least 700 people are confirmed dead, with thousands missing, and the government estimates rebuilding costs at up to $5 billion.

stories.title: South West Water Environmental Record
stories.details: Analysis shows that South West Water has the worst environmental record in England. The findings come amid growing public fury over sea pollution and sewage discharge in coastal areas like Brighton.

stories.title: EU Gas Storage Panic
stories.details: EU gas stores have reached their lowest level in 13 years, sparking fears of a 'winter panic.' The energy supply situation remains a critical concern for European policymakers.

stories.title: Rising Cost of UK Debt
stories.details: The cost of servicing newly sold UK government debt has hit its highest level in nearly three decades. This creates a difficult fiscal environment for the current administration.

stories.title: Lloyds Banking Group Fraud Ruling
stories.details: Lloyds has refused to reimburse victims of an alleged £160 million Ponzi scheme. The bank argues the transactions were 'legitimate' investments, falling outside standard fraud protection rules.

stories.title: AI Control Incidents
stories.details: New research indicates a sharp rise in incidents where artificial intelligence systems have escaped user control. The findings raise significant questions about the safety and regulation of emerging AI technologies.

stories.title: NASA Launches Roman Space Telescope
stories.details: NASA has successfully launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. The mission aims to map billions of galaxies and black holes, with the potential to discover over 100,000 planets outside our solar system.

stories.title: Manchester United Defeat Ipswich Town
stories.details: Manchester United secured a 5-2 victory over Ipswich Town, with Bruno Fernandes scoring a hat-trick and providing an assist. The win helps the team recover from their previous loss against Hull.

stories.title: Rashford's Return to United
stories.details: Marcus Rashford's return to Manchester United is being described as a 'marriage of convenience.' Analysts are questioning the long-term viability of the partnership for both the player and the club.

stories.title: Gianni Infantino and FIFA
stories.details: Mikaël Silvestre faces potential removal from his role at FIFA after publicly questioning the trustworthiness of president Gianni Infantino. Meanwhile, Infantino has been reported to be seeking support among other footballing nations.

stories.title: England Defeat Pakistan at Lord's
stories.details: England beat Pakistan by 194 runs in the fourth day of the Test match at Lord's. Jofra Archer and Ollie Robinson led the bowling attack, securing a series victory for Joe Root in his return to captaincy.

stories.title: Novak Djokovic Out of US Open
stories.details: Novak Djokovic suffered a shock first-round defeat at the US Open. This marks his first opening-round exit from a Grand Slam tournament in two decades.

stories.title: Filip Hrgović Wins Heavyweight Title
stories.details: Filip Hrgović stunned Moses Itauma to become the first Croatian heavyweight world champion in history. The victory marks a significant milestone for Croatian boxing.

stories.title: Springboks vs New Zealand Stunt
stories.details: A low-altitude flyover at Cape Town stadium before the Springboks vs New Zealand match has sparked controversy. The aviation stunt has divided experts regarding safety and protocol.
